_meta.description: Правила DQ по материалам для логического dm_product_general.
_meta.note: Ключи, начинающиеся с _, checker игнорирует. Пустые значения в Conformity пропускаются.

MARA.rule_description: For FG (MTART= ZFG, ZFGS) the value for MEINS should be "CS", "ST" or "PC" in MARA View
technical_definition: For material_description NOT LIKE '%ABP%'
IF base_unit_of_measure_code IS NULL OR general_item_category_group_code = 'ZFGD' THEN ''
ELSE IF material_type_code IN (ZFG, ZFGS) AND general_item_category_group_code NOT IN ('ZCVI', 'ZCVP', 'ZSNK') AND base_unit_of_measure_code IN (CS, PC, ST) THEN '1'
ELSE IF material_type_code IN (ZFG, ZFGS) AND general_item_category_group_code NOT IN ('ZCVI', 'ZCVP', 'ZSNK') AND base_unit_of_measure_code NOT IN (CS, PC, ST) THEN '0'
ELSE ''

MARA.rule_description: For Material Type (MTART)=ZNVL, ZKIT check if MTPOS_MARA = NORM/ZWST in MARA View
technical_definition: For material_description NOT LIKE '%ABP%'
IF general_item_category_group_code IS NULL THEN ''
ELSE IF (material_type_code IN (ZNVL) AND general_item_category_group_code IN ('NORM', 'ZWST')) OR (material_type_code IN (ZKIT) AND general_item_category_group_code IN ('NORM')) THEN '1'
ELSE IF (material_type_code IN (ZNVL) AND general_item_category_group_code NOT IN ('NORM', 'ZWST')) OR (material_type_code IN (ZKIT) AND general_item_category_group_code NOT IN ('NORM')) THEN '0'
ELSE ''

MARA.rule_description: For Material Type (MTART)= ZSV check if MTPOS_MARA = LEIS or ZLIS in MARA View
technical_definition: For material_description NOT LIKE '%ABP%'
IF general_item_category_group_code IS NULL THEN ''
ELSE IF material_type_code IN (ZSV) AND general_item_category_group_code IN ('LEIS', 'ZLIS') THEN '1'
ELSE IF material_type_code IN (ZSV) AND general_item_category_group_code NOT IN ('LEIS', 'ZLIS') THEN '0'
ELSE ''

MARA.rule_description: For Material Type (MTART)= ZSTL check if MTPOS_MARA = LEIS in MARA View
technical_definition: For material_description NOT LIKE '%ABP%'
IF general_item_category_group_code IS NULL THEN ''
ELSE IF material_type_code IN (ZSTL) AND general_item_category_group_code IN ('LEIS') THEN '1'
ELSE IF material_type_code IN (ZSTL) AND general_item_category_group_code NOT IN ('LEIS') THEN '0'
ELSE ''

MARA.rule_description: If MTART = ZFGC the value should be: 1111005, 1111006, 1111007, 1111009, 1113002 in MARA View
technical_definition: For material_description NOT LIKE '%ABP%'
IF material_group_code IS NULL THEN ''
ELSE IF material_type_code = 'ZFGC' AND material_group_code IN (1111005, 1111006, 1111007, 1111009, 1113002) THEN '1'
ELSE IF material_type_code = 'ZFGC' AND material_group_code NOT IN (1111005, 1111006, 1111007, 1111009, 1113002) THEN '0'
ELSE ''

MARA.rule_description: For FG, Minimum Remaining shelf life <= Total shelf life in MARA View
technical_definition: For material_description NOT LIKE '%ABP%'
IF material_type_name_unified = 'Finished Goods' AND remaining_shelf_life <= total_shelf_life THEN '1'
ELSE IF material_type_name_unified = 'Finished Goods' AND remaining_shelf_life > total_shelf_life THEN '0'
ELSE ''

MARA.rule_description: For MTART = ZFG, ZFGS, ZFGC, ZFGM, ZFGA, ZNVM check GEWEI = KG in MARA View
technical_definition: For material_description NOT LIKE '%ABP%'
IF material_type_code IN (ZFG, ZFGS, ZFGC, ZFGM, ZFGA, ZNVM) AND weight_unit = 'KG' THEN '1'
ELSE IF material_type_code IN (ZFG, ZFGS, ZFGC, ZFGM, ZFGA, ZNVM) AND weight_unit != 'KG' THEN '0'
ELSE ''

MARC.rule_description: MRP Type (DISMM) should be ND if Cross-Plant Material Status (MARA.MSTAE) = Blocked for all, otherwise is X0 or ND (finished and semi finished materials) in MARC View
technical_definition: MARC.Plnt/WERKS LIKE '36%' OR '38%' OR '39%'
LOOKUP_MATERIAL_DESCRIPTION contains RU as a separate token
For material_description NOT LIKE '%ABP%'
a = dm_product_plant, b = dm_product_general
IF mrp_type IS NULL OR a.material_status_code != '99' THEN ''

ELSE IF (material_type_code IN (ZFG, ZFGS, ZFGM, ZFGA, ZFGC, ZNVM, ZSF, ZNVL, ZSFT, ZRWT) OR material_type_code LIKE 'ZRW%' OR material_type_code LIKE 'ZSF%') AND ((b.material_status_code = '99' AND mrp_type = 'ND') OR (b.material_status_code != '99' AND mrp_type IN ('X0', 'ND'))) THEN '1'

ELSE IF (material_type_code IN (ZFG, ZFGS, ZFGM, ZFGA, ZFGC, ZNVM, ZSF, ZNVL, ZSFT, ZRWT) OR material_type_code LIKE 'ZRW%' OR material_type_code LIKE 'ZSF%') AND ((b.material_status_code = '99' AND mrp_type != 'ND') OR (b.material_status_code != '99' AND mrp_type NOT IN ('X0', 'ND'))) THEN '0'
ELSE ''
MARC.datamart_or_reference_table_used: dm_product_plant (a) WHERE is_basic_scope = 1 INNER JOIN dm_product_general (b) ON material_code
MARC.check_details_message: Тип MRP (DISMM) должен быть ND, если статус материала (MARA.MSTAE) = 99, в противном случае - X0 или ND в таблице MARC

MVKE.rule_description: For Product Hierarchy, check if for <=749 ml or gr the value is SS or for >= 749 ml or gr the value is MS in MVKE View
technical_definition: For material_description NOT LIKE '%ABP%'
IF ss_sm_flag IS NULL OR product_hierarchy_code IS NULL OR pack_size_code IS NULL OR pack_type_code IS NULL THEN ''
IF filter product_hierarchy_l4_code in the technical SO list OR product_hierarchy_l5_code = '010100120832085' OR product_hierarchy_l3_code = '0206008' is not applicable THEN ''
ELSE IF sales_org_code = '0001' AND distribution_channel_code = '01' AND material_group_code != '1110000' AND material_type_code LIKE 'ZFG%' AND
Case 1: pack_size_code IN ('ZZ') AND pack_type_code NOT IN ('OTH') AND ss_sm_flag = 'SS'
Case 2: pack_size_code IN ('ZZ') AND pack_type_code IN ('OTH') AND ss_sm_flag = 'MS'
Case 3: pack_size_code NOT IN ('ZZ') AND pack_type_code IN ('TNK','BIB','BRL','KEG') AND ss_sm_flag = 'SS'
Case 4: product_hierarchy_code = '010100120832085' AND ss_sm_flag = 'MS'

Case 5.2: same hierarchy AND ((pack_size_uom_unified IN ('ML','G') AND pack_size_volume_unified > 749) OR (pack_size_uom_unified IN ('L','KG') AND pack_size_volume_unified >= 1)) AND ss_sm_flag = 'MS'
ELSE ''
MVKE.datamart_or_reference_table_used: dm_product_sales_org where sales_org_code = '0001' AND distribution_channel_code = '01' INNER JOIN dm_product_general
MVKE.check_details_message: Проверка значения pack_size_name+_+ss_sm_flag в таблице MVKE

MVKE.rule_description: For Product Hierarchy, check if for <=750 ml or gr the value is SS or for >= 750 ml or gr the value is MS in MVKE View
technical_definition: For material_description NOT LIKE '%ABP%'
IF ss_sm_flag IS NULL OR product_hierarchy_code IS NULL OR pack_size_code IS NULL OR pack_type_code IS NULL THEN ''
IF product hierarchy filter is not applicable THEN ''
ELSE IF sales_org_code = '0001' AND distribution_channel_code = '01' AND material_group_code != '1110000' AND material_type_code LIKE 'ZFG%' AND
Case 1: pack_size_code IN ('ZZ') AND pack_type_code NOT IN ('OTH') AND ss_sm_flag = 'SS'
Case 2: pack_size_code IN ('ZZ') AND pack_type_code IN ('OTH') AND ss_sm_flag = 'MS'
Case 3: pack_size_code NOT IN ('ZZ') AND pack_type_code IN ('TNK','BIB','BRL','KEG') AND ss_sm_flag = 'SS'
Case 4.1: product_hierarchy_code IN ('01010012041%','01010012055%','01010012060%') AND pack_size_uom_unified IN ('ML') AND pack_size_volume_unified <= 750 AND ss_sm_flag = 'SS'
Case 4.2: same hierarchy AND ((pack_size_uom_unified IN ('ML') AND pack_size_volume_unified > 750) OR (pack_size_uom_unified IN ('L') AND pack_size_volume_unified >= 1)) AND ss_sm_flag = 'MS'
ELSE ''
MVKE.datamart_or_reference_table_used: dm_product_sales_org where sales_org_code = '0001' AND distribution_channel_code = '01' INNER JOIN dm_product_general
MVKE.check_details_message: Проверка значения pack_size_name+_+ss_sm_flag в таблице MVKE

MVKE.rule_description: For Product Hierarchy, check if for <=999 ml or gr the value is SS or for >= 999 ml or gr the value is MS in MVKE View
technical_definition: For material_description NOT LIKE '%ABP%'
IF ss_sm_flag IS NULL OR product_hierarchy_code IS NULL OR pack_size_code IS NULL OR pack_type_code IS NULL THEN ''
IF product hierarchy filter does not apply THEN ''
ELSE IF sales_org_code = '0001' AND distribution_channel_code = '01' AND material_group_code != '1110000' AND material_type_code LIKE 'ZFG%' AND
Case 1: pack_size_code IN ('ZZ') AND pack_type_code IN ('OTH') AND ss_sm_flag = 'MS'
Case 2: pack_size_code NOT IN ('ZZ') AND pack_type_code IN ('TNK','BIB','BRL','KEG') AND ss_sm_flag = 'SS'
Case 3.1: material_type_code = 'ZFGC' AND coffee_channel_code IN ('CH3','CH4','CH5','CH6') AND coffee_format_code = 'CF1' AND ss_sm_flag = 'SS'
Case 3.2: ZFGC AND coffee_channel_code IN ('CH3') AND coffee_format_code IN ('CF2','CF3') AND ss_sm_flag = 'MS'
Case 3.3: ZFGC AND coffee_channel_code IN ('CH5') AND coffee_format_code IN ('CF2','CF3') AND ss_sm_flag = 'MS'
Case 3.4: ZFGC AND coffee_channel_code IN ('CH4') AND coffee_format_code IN ('CF2','CF4') AND ss_sm_flag = 'MS'
Case 3.5: ZFGC AND coffee_channel_code IN ('CH6') AND coffee_format_code IN ('CF4') AND ss_sm_flag = 'MS'
Case 3.6: ZFGC AND coffee_channel_code IN ('CH3','CH5') AND coffee_format_code IN ('CF4') AND ss_sm_flag = 'SS'
Case 4.1: brand_code = 'CN' OR product_hierarchy_code LIKE '01010012137%' AND pack_size_gram_ml_unified = 800 AND ss_sm_flag = 'MS'
Case 4.2: brand_code = 'CN' OR product_hierarchy_code LIKE '01010012137%' AND pack_size_gram_ml_unified = 250 AND ss_sm_flag = 'SS'
Case 5.1: product_hierarchy_code LIKE '010100221332133%' AND pack_size_gram_ml_unified <= 500 AND ss_sm_flag = 'SS'
Case 5.2: product_hierarchy_code LIKE '010100221332133%' AND pack_size_gram_ml_unified > 500 AND ss_sm_flag = 'MS'
Case 6.1: product_hierarchy_code LIKE '010100221452145%' AND pack_size_gram_ml_unified <= 99 AND ss_sm_flag = 'SS'
Case 6.2: product_hierarchy_code LIKE '010100221452145%' AND pack_size_gram_ml_unified > 99 AND ss_sm_flag = 'MS'
Case 7.1: listed hierarchies AND pack_size_uom_unified IN ('ML','G') AND pack_size_gram_ml_unified <= 999 AND ss_sm_flag = 'SS'
Case 7.2: listed hierarchies AND pack_size_uom_unified IN ('L','KG') AND pack_size_volume_unified >= 1 AND ss_sm_flag = 'MS'
ELSE ''
MVKE.datamart_or_reference_table_used: dm_product_sales_org where sales_org_code = '0001' AND distribution_channel_code = '01' INNER JOIN dm_product_general

MVKE.rule_description: Material Price Group has correct value
technical_definition: IF material_price_group_code IS NULL OR coffee_channel_code IS NULL OR coffee_format_code IS NULL OR ss_sm_flag IS NULL OR material_group_code = '1110000' OR material_type_code NOT IN ('ZFG', 'ZFGS', 'ZFGC', 'ZFGA', 'ZFGM') THEN ''
IF product hierarchy condition is not met THEN ''
IF material_type_code = 'ZFGC' AND coffee_channel_code IN ('CH4','CH5','CH6','CH3') AND coffee_format_code = 'CF1' AND material_pricing_group = '03' THEN 1
ELSE IF material_type_code = 'ZFGC' AND coffee_channel_code IN ('CH3') AND coffee_format_code IN ('CF2','CF3') AND material_pricing_group = '04' THEN 1
ELSE IF material_type_code = 'ZFGC' AND coffee_channel_code IN ('CH5') AND coffee_format_code IN ('CF2','CF3') AND material_pricing_group = '03' THEN 1
ELSE IF material_type_code = 'ZFGC' AND coffee_channel_code IN ('CH4') AND coffee_format_code IN ('CF2','CF4') AND material_pricing_group = '03' THEN 1
ELSE IF material_type_code = 'ZFGC' AND coffee_channel_code = 'CH6' AND coffee_format_code = 'CF4' AND material_pricing_group = '03' THEN 1
ELSE IF material_type_code = 'ZFGC' THEN '0'
ELSE IF pack_type_code IN ('TNK','BIB','BRL','KEG') AND material_pricing_group = '03' THEN 1
ELSE IF pack_size_code = 'ZZ' AND pack_type_code = 'OTH' AND material_pricing_group = '04' THEN 1
ELSE IF (product_hierarchy_l4_code = '01010012137' OR brand_code = 'CN3') AND pack_size_gram_ml_unified = 250 AND material_pricing_group = '03' THEN 1
ELSE IF (product_hierarchy_l4_code = '01010012137' OR brand_code = 'CN3') AND pack_size_gram_ml_unified = 800 AND material_pricing_group = '04' THEN 1
ELSE IF product_hierarchy_l4_code = '01010022145' AND pack_size_gram_ml_unified <= 99 AND material_pricing_group = '03' THEN 1
ELSE IF product_hierarchy_l4_code = '01010022145' AND pack_size_gram_ml_unified > 99 AND material_pricing_group = '04' THEN 1
ELSE IF product_hierarchy_l4_code = '01010022133' AND pack_size_gram_ml_unified <= 500 AND material_pricing_group = '03' THEN 1
ELSE IF product_hierarchy_l4_code = '01010022133' AND pack_size_gram_ml_unified > 500 AND material_pricing_group = '04' THEN 1
ELSE IF product_hierarchy_l4_code = '01010012083' AND material_pricing_group = '04' THEN 1
ELSE IF product_hierarchy_l4_code = '01030052329' AND pack_size_gram_ml_unified <= 100 AND material_pricing_group = '03' THEN 1
ELSE IF product_hierarchy_l4_code = '01030052329' AND pack_size_gram_ml_unified > 100 AND material_pricing_group = '04' THEN 1
ELSE '0'
MVKE.datamart_or_reference_table_used: dm_product_sales_org where sales_org_code = '0001' AND distribution_channel_code = '01' INNER JOIN dm_product_general
MVKE.check_details_message: Проверка корректности значения в поле material_price_group_code

MVKE.rule_description: Field value of Pack Type should be assigned to the same PRODH value in all Sales Org and Distribution Channels for MTART=ZRW,ZSF
technical_definition: IF a.pack_type_code IS NULL OR a.product_hierarchy_code IS NULL THEN ''

IF ((material_type_code = 'ZRW' AND material_group_code IN (1001004, 1001022, 1001024)) OR (material_type_code = 'ZSF' AND pack_type_code = 'ZSY' AND material_group_code IN (1001009))) AND COUNT(DISTINCT pack_type_code, product_hierarchy_code) = 1 GROUP BY material_code THEN '1'
ELSE IF the same scope AND COUNT(DISTINCT pack_type_code, product_hierarchy_code) > 1 GROUP BY material_code THEN '0'
ELSE ''
MVKE.datamart_or_reference_table_used: dm_product_sales_org where sales_org_code = '0001' AND distribution_channel_code = '01' INNER JOIN dm_product_general
MVKE.check_details_message: Проверка соответствия pack_type_code и product_hierarchy_code в таблице MVKE

MVKE.rule_description: Check value against material description (Only for FG) in MVKE View
technical_definition: IF pack_type_code IS NULL OR general_item_category_group_code = 'ZCVI' OR product_hierarchy_l4_code in ('01030052315','01030052301','01030052329','01049992999','01010012123','01010012117') OR product_hierarchy_l3_code in ('0206008') THEN ''
ELSE IF material_type_name_unified = 'Finished Goods' AND material_type_code LIKE 'ZFG%' AND product_hierarchy_code != '01049992999' AND material_description LIKE '%pack_type_code%' THEN '1'
ELSE IF material_type_name_unified = 'Finished Goods' AND material_type_code LIKE 'ZFG%' AND product_hierarchy_code != '01049992999' AND material_description NOT LIKE '%pack_type_code%' THEN '0'
